name: Chad Dupree Memorial Cup
epitaph: The Chad Dupree Memorial Cup's one roll of winners across both hosts: EUWC's four runnings, 2004 to 2007 (Jordan Lockhart, Rocko Daymon, Nero, STEALTH), and TEAM Wrestling's two, 2006 and 2007 (New Era of Wrestling, The A-List). The hosts number it differently: EUWC's 2006 card is the third annual, TEAM's 2006 final the inaugural, and EUWC's event history heads 2006 and 2007 alike “3rd Annual” against the 2007 card's “4th Annual.” Each stands as its page gives it.
